name: lesson-match-dev-1
about: Synthetic (lesson, work) pairs for lesson selection by meaning. A lesson is its title and when it applies; a work is an owner turn's text or a task's title, topic and concern. related is true when the work is a new instance of the lesson's situation, worded differently (few shared terms); false otherwise, and a near miss (near_miss true) shares terms with the lesson but not its situation. Scored by the cosine of the lesson's document vector and the work's query vector to choose the bound. Written from the repository's own words and the mind-improve-1 dev templates, never a held-out split; every name is generic.
sources: sidecar/tests (lesson fixtures of the lesson tests)
